# Security Policy

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](SECURITY.vi.md)

The default service is local-only. Cloudflare Quick Tunnel is optional and disabled unless explicitly enabled. Public-host requests require `QWEN3VL_API_KEY`; missing configuration fails closed.

Do not publish credentials, private URLs, exploit details or user data in issues. Report sensitive problems privately to the repository owner using the contact address on the GitHub profile.
